snippet.title: C64 Longplay: Souls of Darkon (Hokuto Force fix / NTSC mode)
snippet.description: It's been seen before on the Spectrum but the original C64 port had a mashed-up final screen. I had this back in the day and always thought it had an atmospheric graphic style.
